presentation.label: Consistent sample previews
presentation.summary: Preview Flex and Static samples at the default AMP volume, even when the active track is turned down.
presentation.overview: Preview Vol makes FUNC+YES and CUE+YES sample previews use the default AMP VOL (internal value 64, shown as 0). The active track's AMP volume is restored when the preview stops. Track FX, main/cue levels and mixer volumes still apply, so this is not loudness normalization.
highlights: Audition samples even when the active track's AMP VOL is turned down.
The same AMP volume override applies to Flex and Static previews.
Main and cue preview shortcuts use the same behavior.
The track's own AMP volume returns when the preview stops.
usage: Select a Flex or Static audio track and double-tap its TRACK key to open the sample slot list. Select a sample with UP/DOWN or LEVEL.
Hold FUNC and press YES for a main preview, or hold CUE and press YES for a cue preview. Only preview AMP VOL uses the default; sample loudness, FX and track/mixer levels still vary.
Press NO to stop previewing and leave the list. Return to AMP and verify normal track playback retains the stored AMP VOL. Physical audio restoration has not been tested.

access.location: Automatic when included in a build: double-tap a Flex/Static TRACK key for its sample list; YES opens the file browser; MKII AED opens the loaded sample editor.
steps: Include Preview Vol in your Octamod build. It applies automatically to sample auditioning and uses no effect slot.
Select a Flex or Static audio track and double-tap its TRACK key to open the sample slot list. Use UP/DOWN or LEVEL to select a sample.
Hold FUNC and press YES for a main-output preview, or hold CUE and press YES for a cue-output preview. Press NO to stop/leave preview access.
From the sample list, press YES to open LOAD FILE TO FLEX/STATIC. Select a file with UP/DOWN or LEVEL; the same preview shortcuts apply in the file browser.
With a loaded sample on the active track, press AED on MKII to open the audio editor. Use the same preview shortcuts. The corresponding MKI editor route still requires panel verification.
Press AMP to view ATK, HOLD, REL, VOL and BAL. Encoder D changes the track AMP VOL. Preview Vol overrides only preview AMP VOL; track FX, MAIN/CUE LEVEL and mixer volumes remain effective.

limitations: This changes preview AMP VOL only; it does not normalize sample loudness or bypass track FX, track levels or mixer settings.
No effect slot or dedicated module knob; the automatic USB no-UI exception does not apply.

Actual MKII emulator captures show loaded Flex/Static access, file browser, editor and AMP pages. Audio behavior, MKI navigation, hardware timing and restoration after interruption remain unqualified.
Released with owner approval for software verification only: real hardware stress and chip worst-case timing are untested/unmeasured. The waiver covers this version only.

Browser builds match native composition for the currently buildable modules, including Repitch, Scale Quantizer and USB Audio/MIDI. MIDI Scenes is a separate pending update; OctaKit remains outside the catalog.

storage.label: Authored ROM allocation
storage.conditions: One shared ROM allocation, no per-track code copies or new heap/global state. Native alignment reserves up to 127 padding bytes; actual selected placement is checked against free space. See the exact region/accounting report.

processing.label: ColdFire processing
processing.conditions: Real-chip worst-case cycles and deadline/headroom under contention are unmeasured. Owner-approved exact-version release waiver; emulator and assembly checks are not chip timing.

impact.conditions: One shared handler with up to eight audio tracks; dense incoming MIDI control or rapid Flex/Static previews. Estimates describe added module work and do not promise timing headroom.

cpu.rationale: Event-driven ColdFire code; no added DSP algorithm or per-sample DSP work. Two four-instruction preview stubs, selected once per preview start.

dsp.rationale: No authored DSP code, tables, buffers or additional effect slots. Existing stock processing still applies.

memory.rationale: 36 authored ROM bytes, up to 127 alignment bytes, no newly allocated heap or persistent RAM. Existing stock state is reused.

tests.summary: Native/browser byte parity passed for all 1,024 supported selections: 522 exact images and 502 matching refusals. Eight full native upgrades and actual browser downloads match. Authored assembly/relocation and MKII LCD documentation checked. Physical stress, audio behavior and chip timing remain untested/unmeasured under the owner’s exact-version waiver.

releaseWaiver.reason: Owner explicitly approved these two modules with software verification, no physical hardware run and chip timing marked unmeasured. Applies only to the pinned complete source version.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial
steps: Select a Flex or Static audio track, load a sample and double-tap its TRACK key to open the slot list.
Press AMP and turn encoder D to reduce the track AMP VOL; return to the sample list and hold FUNC while pressing YES to preview through main. Use CUE+YES to audition through cue.
Press NO to stop/leave preview access. Verify normal track playback uses the stored AMP VOL; compare both Flex and Static, then repeat from the file browser and MKII audio editor.
